scenes.say: Hello from Ricky Rampersad Branch. We're now on WhatsApp.
You may get a short, friendly note about your policy, so nothing slips by.
Tap a button to tell us you've paid, ask for help, or ask us to call you.
Prefer not to get these? Just reply stop, and we'll stop.
Message Help eight six eight on WhatsApp any time. We're here for you.
